title: Hayya ala qairil amal hayya ala qairil amal
body:
Hayya ala qairil amal hayya ala qairil amal
lo aagaya mahe aza hayya ala qairil amal. aur bichgayi farshe aza hayya ala qairil amal.
1. Phir rounaqe hamaare gharaane me aagayi.
<<MINI>>
(hayya alal aza, hayya alal buka).
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ghar hai matam ki sada hayya ala qairil amal
2. Aaho buka o matame sarwar a.s ki shakl me.
<<MINI>>
(hayya alal aza, hayya alal buka).
<<DIVIDER>>
you'n ajre risaalat ho ada hayya ala qairil amal.
3. Hai zindagi to bas isi matam ke waaste.
<<MINI>>
(hayya alal aza, hayya alal buka).
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaane'n hamari ho fida hayya ala qairil amal
4. Matam yeh ruk na paayega Zehra (s.a) ke laal ka.
<<MINI>>
(hayya alal aza, hayya alal buka)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Syeda (s.a) ki hai dua hayya ala qairil amal
5. Gham me Hussain (asws) ke jo rulayega royega
<<MINI>>
(hayya alal aza, hayya alal buka).
<<DIVIDER>>
Raazi hain usse Fatima (s.a) hayya ala qairil amal.
6. Qushnoodi e Khuda o Aimma(asws) ke waaste.
<<MINI>>
(hayya alal aza, hayya alal buka).
<<DIVIDER>>
Majlis karo ghar mein bapa hayya alaa khairil amal.
7.
Mirza Kumail
karti hai aelaan
Asghari
<<MINI>>
(hayya alal-aza, hayya alal-buka).
<<DIVIDER>>
Matam karo shabbir (asws) ka hayya alaa qairil amal
